# The Account Hub placeholder is a whole localized button backed by mirrored small icons

The placeholder is one button outside the dialog, with its icon before the title, and the container attaches the toggle listener to that whole button. Its Fluent title names Maximize Account Hub. The minimize/maximize variables use -sm, map to packaged 16 by 16 SVGs and feed widget classes that mirror in RTL. These are exact source/resource contracts. Empty decorative image alt text and localized titles do not by themselves prove an accessible name, hit-target size or VoiceOver result.

Scope: Account Hub placeholder resources and controls.
